# Marina Muchakova (Марина Мучакова) — muchakova.com

> Marina Muchakova — tax consultant with a law degree and over 15 years of experience: crypto tax and MiCA, investment income, international tax, business.

## About

Marina Muchakova is a tax consultant with a law degree and over 15 years of experience in Bulgarian and EU tax law. She specialises in:

- Crypto taxation and blockchain-related financial compliance
- Investment income taxation (bonds, equities, government securities)
- Double Taxation Avoidance Treaties (application and planning)
- Business structuring and profit optimisation
- MiCA (Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation) prudential assessments and stress testing

She works across three main projects:
- **Vesta Consult**: An accounting firm and consultancy where I am a managing partner. The team serves companies and individuals: monthly bookkeeping, annual tax returns, crypto accounting, investment fund bookkeeping, translations and document legalisation. (https://vesta-bg.eu)
- **The Crypto Academy**: An educational crypto and blockchain project running seminars in partnership with UNWE, Expert Events, Themida Training Centre, Kitov Centre, Finance Academy, Invest Pro, Invest Club and others. (https://thecrypto.academy)
- **NABI**: I am a member of the National Association for Blockchain and Innovation, a non-profit organisation bridging the gap between business and public administration in the technology sector, with a mission to create a favourable environment for investment and a technology crypto hub in Bulgaria.
